column1: # name|kind|template|doc      ($0 marks where the caret goes; \n and \t are escapes)
# Kinds: EFFECT (completion_reward), TRIGGER (available/bypass), SCOPE (both), ANY (both), ICON
# This is a starter list. Use Tools > Import Clausewitz docs... to load the full list from your game.
set_stability|EFFECT|set_stability = $0|Set stability to a fixed value
set_war_support|EFFECT|set_war_support = $0|Set war support to a fixed value
add_to_faction|EFFECT|add_to_faction = $0|Add a country to your faction
transfer_state|EFFECT|transfer_state = $0|Transfer a state (by id) to the scoped country
add_state_core|EFFECT|add_state_core = $0|Add a core on a state (by id)
remove_state_core|EFFECT|remove_state_core = $0|Remove a core from a state (by id)
add_core_of|EFFECT|add_core_of = $0|State scope: add a core for a country
hidden_effect|EFFECT|hidden_effect = {\n\t$0\n}|Run effects without showing a tooltip
effect_tooltip|EFFECT|effect_tooltip = {\n\t$0\n}|Show effects in the tooltip without running them
set_capital|EFFECT|set_capital = $0|Move the capital to a state (by id)
load_focus_tree|EFFECT|load_focus_tree = $0|Switch the country to another focus tree
log|EFFECT|log = "$0"|Write a line to the game log
ROOT|SCOPE||The country the effect started in
FROM|SCOPE||The scope that triggered this one
every_other_country|SCOPE||Every country except the current one
every_enemy_country|SCOPE||Every country at war with you
is_puppet_of|TRIGGER|is_puppet_of = $0|Is a puppet of a country
is_owned_by|TRIGGER|is_owned_by = $0|State scope: owned by a country
is_controlled_by|TRIGGER|is_controlled_by = $0|State scope: controlled by a country
NOT|ANY|NOT = {\n\t$0\n}|True when none of the conditions are true
OR|ANY|OR = {\n\t$0\n}|At least one condition must be true
